title: How Albert Walters got the name Fernandez and the nickname Badda
summary: He explains that his stepfather's name stuck as Fernandez, and that Paul Barbarin nicknamed him Badda, advertising him as Kid Badda.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Albert Vincent Paul Walters, known as musician Fernandez. How did you get that name? Why did they call you that?

Well, my stepfather raised me and that name just followed Fernandez. And practically all the older musicians know me by the name of Fernandez. I mean my son, Albert's son is a trumpet player and he introduced himself and nobody knows, he's older people, so you've got to explain the name of Fernandez. Then they recognized him, well yeah, I know your father good. And then, Sandra Gordon, a fellow met my son and told him, I don't know Walter. I said, you don't? No, so a fellow buddy told him, a guitar player, he said, well that's Albert Fernandez's son. I said, oh, I used to play jitney dance years ago with your dad.
Well you've got some other nicknames too, Badda, huh?
Badda, yeah. Well Paul gave me that name years ago. Which Paul?
Paul gave me that name when he went with Louis Russell. He used to call me Badda.
It's just a name I never could know what it means. He used to advertise me on the placard like that. Kid Badda.
How's it spelled? How would they spell it then?

I don't know, I don't have an idea how to spell it. He used to spell it one way and some people said it was incorrect, you know. And it's spelled another way and some of them spelled it different way, but I never did know the meaning of it.
